## Net effect

Three sev-1s close (J-2, E-1, and the schema half of D-1/F-1); one sev-1
half-closes (K-2); one issue (A-1 stack) is reframed as a recorded-decision
gap rather than an engineering gap. The bulk of the backlog (content,
interactivity, learner-facing surfaces) is untouched by the misconception
work and remains the real forward agenda.
